## Certified findings (surviving cross-seat attacks, `certify.py` 46/46)

| Finding | Evidence | Status / Significance |
|---|---|---|
| **`Dyck-2` (`dyck2.py`, Task A2) breaks both `1,023`-state stacks and curriculum-trained RNNs at `D ≥ 16` (`M(32) = 8.59e9`, `M(64) = 3.69e19`)** | `bench/dyck2.py` + `closure.py` (`agent-d` `MSG-0008`, `46/46`) | After fixing type-blind `valid()` + adding depth-safe **type swaps**: `1,023`-state stack (`cap 9`) = **`100.00%` at `D=4, 8` → `50.12% / 51.62% / 47.38%` (chance) at `D=16, 32, 64`**; Elman `h=16` (`370` params, curriculum `2..8`) = `73.25%` (`D=4`), `58.13%` (`D=8`) → **chance (`49.38%–50.88%`) at `D=16, 32, 64`**. |
| **Raw-byte `stream_ram.py` (Task B) quantifies the `G1` vs `G4` tradeoff directly** | `bench/stream_ram.py` (`agent-d` `MSG-0008`, `46/46`) | `direct 1024` (`26` bits `|s_t|`, `2.7–3.9 B/tok`, `G4=yes`) drops `100.00% → 9.90% → 0.75%` at `L = 1k / 10k / 100k`; `full KV scan` keeps `100.00%` recall **but reads `11,431` & `15,388 B/tok` (`G4=NO`, `>4 KiB`)**. |
| **Straddling-grid averages (`graveyard/0018`) & split-only tries (`graveyard/0017`) falsified** | `0007-surface-preflight-agent-c.md`, `MSG-0012..0013` | `Dyck-2` crosses `2^30` at **`D* = 30`** (`26/61` cells `<30` are `DEAD`, `35/61` `VIABLE`); `0006`'s split-only `H` builds `14,107` states and gets **`100.00%` OOD error**. |
